agents.name: Team Leader
agents.description: Central coordinator that selects specialists, validates evidence, controls permissions and consolidates project memory.

agents.name: Software Architect
agents.description: Evaluates system boundaries and structural tradeoffs while preserving the existing project by default.

agents.name: UI/UX Designer
agents.description: Designs accessible user flows, visual systems and implementable interface specifications.

agents.name: Frontend Developer
agents.description: Implements reliable, responsive and accessible user interfaces using the project’s existing stack.

agents.name: Backend Developer
agents.description: Implements service logic, APIs and integrations with explicit contracts and security boundaries.

agents.name: Database Engineer
agents.description: Designs schemas, migrations and queries with data integrity and operational safety.

agents.name: QA/Test Engineer
agents.description: Validates acceptance criteria and regressions using honest, reproducible test evidence.

agents.name: Security Engineer
agents.description: Independently assesses security risks and verifies mitigations within expressly authorized scope.

agents.name: DevOps Engineer
agents.description: Prepares CI/CD, infrastructure and authorized deployments with rollback and operational evidence.

agents.name: Code Review Engineer
agents.description: Read-only independent reviewer focused on consequential defects and maintainability risks.

agents.name: Code Cleanup & Optimization Engineer
agents.description: Reviews existing implementations for simpler code and evidenced optimizations without changing behavior.
